name: base-blocked-unlock-pickup
task: Pick up the blocking ball and the key, in either order, unlock the door, and then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task says to pick up the blocking ball and the key, in either order, then unlock the door. The clauses only require blocker_moved and has_door_key before door_open; Precedence does not require either to happen. Add a hard Precedence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) or Precedence(has_door_key, blocker_moved) to require both before unlocking without imposing an order between them.

CHANGES REQUIRED: R3, hard Existence(door_open), is redundant. R1 with R2 already requires the door to open before the target is picked up, so R3 adds no requirement. Remove R3; keep the other clauses, which require the ball and key before opening the door, then the target box.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: The two hard Precedence clauses require the blocker moved and key acquired before the door opens; hard Existence(target_picked_up) requires the box, and Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) enforces the stated order.
